extracted.intended_audience: University of Canterbury mathematics students, researchers, and staff looking for theses
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for locating University of Canterbury and other national/international mathematics and statistics theses (digital and print), including search tips, repository links, digitisation and borrowing procedures, and embargo information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Library Research Guides for writing and depositing your thesis
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on writing and depositing your thesis is available on the Library’s Research Guides.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page points to Library Research Guides and PhD and doctoral study resources (including 'PhD policy and guidelines at UC') for detailed instructions on thesis writing and depositing. Use those guides for formal requirements and deposit procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Locate recent UC mathematics theses via provided lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Recent Mathematics theses are in digital (PDF) format and can be found within these two lists: Masters theses in Mathematics; Doctoral theses in Mathematics. Masters theses in Statistics; Doctoral theses in Statistics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specific masters/doctoral thesis lists for the Mathematics and Statistics subjects to find recent digitized theses.

rubrics_metrics.name: UC Research Repository access for non-embargoed PhD theses
rubrics_metrics.description: All non-embargoed UC PhD theses are digitized and can be downloaded from the UC Research Repository (open access). Masters theses are in progress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For full-text UC PhD theses check the UC Research Repository. Note that masters theses may not all yet be digitized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request digitisation of specific theses
rubrics_metrics.description: To request digitisation of a specific thesis email collections@libr.canterbury.ac.nz. It may take up to 10 working days to complete this request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a thesis you need is not yet digitized, submit an email request to the collections address and allow up to 10 working days for processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargoes may restrict online availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Some theses may be unavailable until a certain date due to sensitive content. You may wish to contact the author for more information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a thesis is embargoed it will not be available online; contact the author for information about access or embargo end dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Borrowing and requesting print theses
rubrics_metrics.description: Theses on the open shelves can be borrowed. Theses in storage can be requested online through our catalogue and used within the Macmillan Brown Library: the delivery timeframe is the following working day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the library catalogue to request stored print theses; open-shelf theses are borrowable. Expect next-working-day delivery for storage requests and on-site use in Macmillan Brown for some items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search the Library Catalogue by author, title, or keyword with 'thesis canterbury <subject>'
rubrics_metrics.description: You can search in the Library Catalogue by: Author, Title, Keyword. Enter the terms 'thesis' and 'Canterbury' followed by the subject discipline, e.g. 'thesis canterbury chemistry'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formulate searches as 'thesis canterbury <subject>' to find UC theses in a discipline. Try author/title/keyword searches as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be aware of cross-subject results and consult subject guides
rubrics_metrics.description: NB: This may find theses in other subjects, e.g. 'thesis canterbury history' picks up theses in art history, business history etc, while 'thesis canterbury philosophy' will find PhD (Doctor of Philosophy) theses in all subjects. For these cases, some subject guides include thesis lists, including for classics and philosophy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If catalogue searches return cross-disciplinary results, narrow by subject or consult the relevant subject guide which may include curated thesis lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use NZresearch for New Zealand theses
rubrics_metrics.description: NZresearch.org.nz links to full-text research online at New Zealand universities, polytechnics, and other research organisations, including theses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For NZ-wide thesis discovery and full-text where available, search NZresearch. For print theses, interloan may be possible but usually under strict conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overseas theses discovery and interloan limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Recent theses from overseas are increasingly made available online. Older theses can be difficult to interloan and may have to be purchased. Proquest Dissertation and Theses provides citations only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect variability: many recent overseas theses are online, older ones may be hard to obtain, and some services (e.g., ProQuest) only provide citations rather than full text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use international/national thesis discovery services
rubrics_metrics.description: The page lists multiple discovery services for theses: Networked Digital Library of Theses and Dissertations (NDLTD); Open Access Theses and Dissertations (OATD); OAIster; American Doctoral Dissertations; Trove (Australia); Theses Canada Portal; SUDOC (France); Dissertations Online (Germany and Switzerland); DIVA (Sweden); EThOS (UK); BASE; CORE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search these services for international or country-specific theses collections. Note differences in coverage and availability of full-text across services; set content filters where available (e.g., OAIster content options, Theses Canada 'Electronic theses').

rubrics_metrics.name: Check subject-specific databases for thesis records
rubrics_metrics.description: Many subject-specific databases include records of theses and dissertations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In addition to general thesis repositories, search discipline-specific databases and indexes for thesis records relevant to your topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Further country-specific thesis collections and discovery engines
rubrics_metrics.description: There is a list of further country specific thesis collections. BASE and CORE are mentioned as large discovery indexes containing many thesis records.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot find a thesis via general services, consult country-specific collections or broad academic search engines like BASE and CORE to broaden discovery.
